key_concepts: Fingerprints are unique to each person, even between twins.
Fingerprints commonly form loop, whorl, or arch patterns.
A hand lens magnifies small details for closer observation.
Hand span is a nonstandard unit for measuring length.
A ruler can draw straight lines and measure length.
Air released from a balloon can push objects and make them move.
With the same push, a lighter ball rolls farther than a heavier ball of the same size.
A hard-boiled egg spins longer than a fresh egg because its contents are solid.
Plucking a ruler makes it vibrate and produce sound.
Changing the length of a vibrating ruler changes the sound it makes.
Asking questions is an important science practice when observing phenomena.
